<h1>Empirical Valve / Component Weight Estimation — Reproducible Model Specification</h1><p><b>Status:</b> Final / implementation-complete. <b>Date:</b> 2026-08-10. <b>Canonical master:</b> <code>docs/Masters/wtValveweights.xlsx</code> and <code>docs/Masters/wtValveweights.json</code>. <b>Pinned derivation source:</b> <code>b168cced3f5aaaada15de290d14ce64928a9a7a3</code>.</p><p>This file is self-contained for implementation. It specifies both approaches and embeds a gzip+Base64 machine payload containing all 270 Approach 1 production equations, full-precision coefficients/band cuts, all Approach 2 stack matrices, constants, and aggregate validation metrics. The runtime size×rating weight matrix is deterministically rebuilt from the canonical master by median cell aggregation; there is no hidden factor matrix.</p><h2>1. Inputs and output</h2><pre>size = NS if numeric and >0, else DN if numeric and >0&#10;rating = positive numeric Rating&#10;target = positive numeric RF/RTJ KG or BW KG&#10;A2 cell = median target for identical TypeDesc,size,rating</pre><p>Return weightKg, target, approach (EXACT/A2_MATRIX/A1_SIZE_BAND/EXTRAPOLATED), typeDesc, size, rating, modelId, confidence (EXACT/HIGH/MEDIUM/EQUATION/LOW), component predictions band/ratio/cross, and actual normalized weights used.</p><h2>2. Approach 1 — size-banded equations</h2><pre>LOG1: W=exp(a+b*ln(NS))&#10;LOG2: W=exp(a+b*ln(NS)+c*ln(NS)^2)&#10;RAW1: W=a+b*NS&#10;RAW2: W=a+b*NS+c*NS^2</pre><p>Use natural log. Per target+TypeDesc+Rating test 1–3 contiguous bands; require at least 5 rows and 4 unique sizes per band; test all four forms. Analytical LOO uses beta=pinv(X'X)X'y, yfit=X beta, h_i=x_i'pinv(X'X)x_i, yloo_i=y_i-(y_i-yfit_i)/(1-h_i). LOG models fit ln(W) then exp. Reject if 1-h_i&lt;1e-6, nonpositive, or nonfinite. Within band rank by max ±15% hits, then min summed APE, then lower degree. Partition score=total_hits-0.25*(bands-1), then lower APE, then fewer bands. Selected groups: RF 20 one-band/52 two-band/18 three-band; BW 7/26/11.</p><p>Production routing: match target+TypeDesc+Rating; outside observed group NS min/max is extrapolation. Inside range use payload lowerCut/upperCut: first size&lt;=upperCut; middle lowerCut&lt;size&lt;=upperCut; last size&gt;lowerCut. Blank outer cut is open routing only, not permission to extrapolate. Evaluate payload model with full-precision a,b,c.</p><pre>A1 validation: RF N=1502 MAPE=10.99% median=6.35% P90=22.57% within±15=84.09%; BW N=782 MAPE=11.41% median=6.76% P90=28.85% within±15=82.23%</pre><h2>3. Approach 2 — matrix-assisted stack</h2><p>Build M[size,rating]=median positive target within one TypeDesc and target. For validation remove the whole target cell.</p><h3>Estimator A: collaborative rating-ratio P_ratio</h3><pre>P_anchor=M[s,r0]*exp(L(s;r,r0)); log_ratio(x)=ln(M[x,r]/M[x,r0])</pre><p>Median duplicate ratios. Exact target-size ratio if present; otherwise bracketed linear interpolation versus ln(size). One-sided: nearest up to 4, fit L=beta0+beta1*ln(size), beta=pinv(X'X+diag(0,0.2))X'y, then Lfinal=0.6*Lreg+0.4*median(side); one point uses it. Anchor distance d=abs(ln(r/r0)); anchor weight=[1/(0.15+d)]*max(1,n_ratio_points)^0.3; combine anchors by weighted geometric mean. If no rating anchor: same-rating bracket log-log; else >=2 same-rating points use nearest up to 3 same-side OLS ln(W) on [1,ln(size)]; else unavailable.</p><h3>Estimator B: local cross-ratio P_cross</h3><pre>P_rect=M[s,r0]*M[s0,r]/M[s0,r0]&#10;d=sqrt(ln(s/s0)^2+ln(r/r0)^2); weight=1/(0.1+d)^3</pre><p>Use valid s0!=s,r0!=r rectangles; sort distance; keep nearest 12. If >=5, calculate log predictions, median log and absolute log deviations, discard above 90th percentile deviation (10% tail). Weighted geometric mean of remaining rectangles. No rectangle=unavailable.</p><h3>Final stack and training</h3><pre>ln(P_A2)=[w_band ln(P_band)+w_ratio ln(P_ratio)+w_cross ln(P_cross)]/sum(available weights)</pre><p>Drop unavailable/nonpositive predictors and renormalize. P_band is A1. Training: family=TypeDesc; grouped cell=(NS,Rating); 5 folds; random seed 31; nonnegative simplex grid step 0.10; objective training-fold MAPE; production family weights are arithmetic mean of five fold-optimal triplets; fewer than five unique cells uses A1 only.</p><p><b>RF production weights (band,ratio,cross):</b> Blind Flange=.12,.04,.84; Flanged Ball Valve -Full Bore=.56,.26,.18; Flanged Ball Valve -Short Pattern=.64,.20,.16; Flanged Ball Valve-Reduced Bore=.66,.06,.28; Flanged Control Valve=.20,.64,.16; Flanged Gate Valve=.38,.58,.04; Flanged Globe Valve=.44,.06,.50; Flanged Swing check Valve=.38,.62,.00; Flanged wafer Valve=.82,.16,.02; Instrument-ESDV/UZV=.34,.16,.50; Instrument-XCV=.18,.14,.68; Lug type Valve=.82,.12,.06; SPECTACLE BLIND=.82,.00,.18; Triple Offset Flanged Butterfly valve=.90,.02,.08; Wafer type Valve=.34,.56,.10; Weldneck Flange=.50,.22,.28; Weldneck Flange Series A=.92,.08,.00; Weldneck Flange Series B=.10,.64,.26.</p><p><b>BW production weights (band,ratio,cross):</b> Flanged Ball Valve -Short Pattern=.38,.48,.14; Flanged Ball Valve-Reduced Bore=.46,.24,.30; Flanged Control Valve=.36,.40,.24; Flanged Gate Valve=.38,.58,.04; Flanged Globe Valve=.24,.68,.08; Flanged Swing check Valve=.46,.54,.00; Instrument-ESDV/UZV=.32,.16,.52; Instrument-XCV=.18,.10,.72.</p><pre>A2 validation: RF N=1502 MAPE=9.99% median=6.19% P90=18.23% within±15=84.75%; BW N=782 MAPE=9.52% median=6.27% P90=20.48% within±15=82.23%. Less-than-10% is aggregate MAPE, not every family.</pre><h2>4. Deployment</h2><pre>1 EXACT: exact median master cell -> return it&#10;2 A2_MATRIX: compute band/ratio/cross and family stack, renormalized over available predictors&#10;3 A1_SIZE_BAND: if matrix support absent but A1 is in validated group range -> equation&#10;4 EXTRAPOLATED: only if caller permits; confidence LOW</pre><p>Confidence: EXACT exact cell; HIGH both matrix predictors; MEDIUM band+one matrix predictor; EQUATION in-range A1; LOW extrapolated/weak support. Instrument-XCV remains input-limited by missing actuator/model/body-series variables.</p><h2>5. Machine-readable complete model payload</h2><p>Decode with Python: <code>json.loads(gzip.decompress(base64.b64decode(PAYLOAD)).decode('utf-8'))</code>. Assert <code>len(MODEL['approach1']['models'])==270</code>. Each A1 record contains target,typeDesc,rating,band,nsMin,nsMax,lowerCut,upperCut,model,a,b,c. A2 stackWeights[target][typeDesc] is [band,ratio,cross].</p><pre>MODEL_PAYLOAD_GZIP_</pre><h2>6. Deterministic constants</h2><pre>A1 maxBands=3; minRows=5; minUniqueSizes=4; forms=LOG1,LOG2,RAW1,RAW2; extraBandPenaltyHits=0.25; min(1-h)=1e-6&#10;A2 cellAggregation=median; ratio ln(size)/ln(weight ratio); oneSidePoints=4; ridgeDiag=(0,0.2); extrapBlend=(0.6 regression,0.4 median); ratingDistance=abs(ln(r/r0)); ratingOffset=0.15; supportExponent=0.3&#10;A2 sameRatingFallback=bracket log-log else nearest3 same-side log-linear; crossOffset=0.1; crossPower=3; crossNearest=12; crossTrim=10% if >=5; combine=weighted geometric mean&#10;meta folds=5; seed=31; simplexStep=0.10; objective=MAPE; missing predictor=drop+renormalize</pre><h2>7. Regeneration</h2><p>When wtValveweights materially changes, regenerate all A1 formula rows, A2 stack weights, and validation metrics with the same algorithms/constants and update the source commit. Do not hand-edit individual coefficients without revalidation.</p><p><b>Conclusion:</b> Approach 1 is fully defined by the generic forms/routing plus the embedded 270-row payload. Approach 2 is fully defined by the median runtime size×rating matrix, ratio/cross reconstruction algorithms, exact constants and family stack matrices. This note is sufficient for another agent to implement and reproduce the estimator.</p>
